Class GuiController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.view.GuiController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class GuiController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
JavaFX controller for the main game view. Manages the game UI, handles keyboard input, and coordinates rendering.
